evidence: The paper uses only traditional epidemiological regression methods: "The type of regression was determined by the outcomes: (1) generalized linear models with Poisson distribution using robust variance error estimation for binary outcomes; (2) linear regression for continuous outcomes; and (3) Cox proportional hazards regression for time-to-event outcomes." No random forests, tree-based methods, or impurity importance are mentioned. Conclusions rely on effect estimates from these regression models, not on variable importance rankings.
